title: ufi: a reference implementation of User First Intelligence and the Content Gap Score
description: Content gap scoring from industry structure and user questions: a reference implementation of the Content Gap Score at entity, relation and class level, the practitioner baselines it is compared against, and the reproducibility artifacts a study of it must publish (frozen query set, parameter lock, auditable judgment cache, run manifest). Includes a corrected numbering-plan ontology with OWL 2 and SHACL export, executable competency questions with schema and coverage pass rates, and the twelve-prefix two-instrument cross-section (12 October 2026) released with the manuscript. The score is a specification; no published study has tested whether it predicts anything.
